title: 造假退市五年后，它成了中国咖啡第一 | Luckin's Wild Ride ☕
description:
瑞幸还是星巴克，你站哪一杯？评论区告诉我。

2017 年成立、2019 年登陆纳斯达克的瑞幸，上市仅 400 天就爆出财务造假——虚增收入约 22 亿元，2020 年 6 月被摘牌，和解罚款约 1.8 亿美元。几乎所有人都以为它完了。可五年后，它成了中国规模最大的连锁咖啡品牌：2024 财年营收 344.75 亿元，反超星巴克中国；国内外门店数近 3 万家，约为星巴克中国的 3 倍多。2025 年 6 月，它甚至开回纽约，把店开在了星巴克对面。一场从退市到三万家店的过山车。

Luckin Coffee was founded in 2017 and listed on Nasdaq in 2019 — then, just 400 days after its IPO, an accounting-fraud scandal broke: sales inflated by roughly ¥2.2B, delisted in June 2020, settled with a ~$180M fine. Almost everyone wrote it off. Five years later it's China's largest coffee chain: FY2024 revenue of ¥34.5B overtook Starbucks China, its store count neared 30,000 (over 3× Starbucks China), and in June 2025 it reopened in New York — right across from Starbucks. From delisting to 30,000 stores, quite a ride.

Facts only, no endorsement or investment view. AI-assisted edit; the subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
